data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 958 experienced a net release of GBP 17.295 million in prior year reserves, representing a 4.14% reduction of opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was driven by positive reserve development relating to prior periods, including an improvement in old years' catastrophe events, which led to reserve releases across Global Property and Global Specialty business units, as well as favourable developments on Casualty and Motor XL classes. The 2012 year of account closed with a profit despite prior losses from events like Superstorm Sandy and Costa Concordia, indicating favourable development on these older events. Reinsurance inwards also contributed significantly to the overall release.
